OFFICIAL TEXT: 《官方詳情頁沒有 SYNOPSIS只有購票須知與海報。 海報逐字:『On That Stage / MUSICAL DREAM HIGH REBOOT / 뮤지컬 드림하이 시즌3 리부트 / 2026. 11. 7 SAT 17:00 공주문예회관 대공연장 / 출연 세븐, 유영재, 유권, 선예, 김다현, 조남희, 심건우』。 劇情須由外部來源補:뉴스1 2026-08-12『작품은 최정상 K팝 스타였던 송삼동의 실종 이후, 새로운 꿈을 향해 달려가는 기린예고 학생들의 이야기를 그린다』;KONTENX / ARTONE COMPANY 官方『이야기는 해외 쇼케이스를 앞둔 기린예고에서 다시 시작된다. 글로벌 스타를 육성하기 위해 성과와 경쟁만이 우선인 새로운 교육 시스템 속에서 교사 강오혁은 뒤처진…』》 OFFICIAL CHARACTER LIST: 《강오혁 — 기린예고 교사,培養出삼동的老師(namu:『완벽해지려다 오히려 무너지는 제자를 이미 한 번 지켜봤기에, 꿈을 꾸는 아이들을 대할 때도 서두르지 않는다』)/ 송삼동 — 曾是頂尖 K-POP 巨星,失蹤/ 기린예고 學生們(新角色群)》
synopsis:
At Kirin Arts High School, preparations for an overseas showcase are already under way when the disappearance of Song Samdong casts a long shadow over the students. Once a top K-pop star and a figure shaped by the school, Samdong has vanished, leaving behind both unanswered questions and the daunting image of a dream fulfilled, then abruptly lost.

The school now operates under a new educational system built to produce global stars. Achievement, evaluation, and competition take precedence, and the pressure to stand out becomes inseparable from the students' pursuit of the stage. As they train for the showcase, the students of Kirin Arts High School must confront what it means to chase a future in an environment that measures them chiefly by results. Their ambitions propel them forward, yet the demand to become exceptional threatens to leave those who cannot keep pace behind.

Teacher Kang Ohhyeok watches them closely. Having once seen a student collapse while trying too hard to become perfect, he refuses to hurry young people who are still learning how to dream. Samdong's absence makes that lesson more urgent: the students are not merely preparing a performance, but trying to find a way to move toward new dreams without losing themselves to fear, comparison, or the expectations imposed upon them.

As the overseas showcase approaches, the students continue toward the stage together. In the space between Samdong's unresolved disappearance and their own uncertain futures, they must decide whether success alone is the destination, or whether their dreams can retain their meaning even amid competition.

The musical considers the cost of pursuing excellence in a system ruled by performance and results. It ultimately centres on young people protecting their own dreams, learning to endure uncertainty, and finding the courage to keep moving forward together.
